title: Kristian Kerr
summary: Kristian Kerr drives the broad house investment view for LPL Financial Research. His career includes over 25 years of industry experience.
body_markdown:
# Kristian Kerr


Head of Macro and Investment Strategy


Kristian Kerr is Head of Macro and Investment Strategy at LPL Financial, where he leads the firm's Strategic and Tactical Asset Allocation Committee (STAAC). In this role, he helps shape LPL Research's investment outlook, directs the firm's macro and market views, and oversees the top-down asset allocation guidance that drives LPL's model portfolios. In addition to his broader strategic responsibilities, Kristian serves as Co-Chair of the Alternatives Model Portfolio Committee, the team responsible for the management and oversight of the LPL Research alternatives model and paper portfolios. With more than 25 years of experience in global financial markets, Kristian brings a diverse background spanning asset allocation, macro strategy, portfolio management, and trading.


## Before joining LPL Financial


Prior to joining LPL, he served as Western Region Head of Foreign Exchange and Macro at Citi Private Bank in San Francisco. Before joining Citi, he spent seven years in New York as a portfolio manager for a large systematic macro hedge fund. Throughout his career, Kristian has also held a variety of investment strategy and trading roles at leading global financial institutions.


### Education & Achievements


BBA in International Business, Schiller International University in Madrid, Spain.
